findings.summary: Current guide still documents the retired seven-stage pipeline
findings.suggestion: Change both locale guides and Architecture to six stages and remove plan from current sequences.

reasoning.observe: Both guides and Architecture retain current seven-stage wording contrary to S1/AC-001.
reasoning.trace: Readers encounter contradictory current instructions after the new six-stage contract block.
reasoning.infer: Users can try the retired plan command while validation remains green.
reasoning.conclude: The living documentation violates S1 and AC-001.

findings.summary: Required contract sections omit mechanisms and version files
findings.suggestion: Require all five marker keys in every CONTRACT_DOCS file and add missing-section tests.

reasoning.observe: Only pipeline, agents, and skills are mandatory.
reasoning.trace: Removing mechanisms or version-files yields no error.
reasoning.infer: Two required surfaces can disappear silently.

findings.summary: Postpublish retries occur immediately without propagation backoff
findings.suggestion: Poll with bounded backoff and a total deadline; test delayed evidence.

reasoning.observe: Retries run in a tight loop despite the PLAN propagation-risk mitigation.
reasoning.trace: The job queries services immediately after publication.
reasoning.infer: All attempts can finish inside one transient consistency window.
reasoning.conclude: A correct release can falsely fail.

findings.suggestion: Add bounded backoff or deadline-based polling between unavailable responses.

reasoning.observe: Bounded attempts are consecutive with no wait.
reasoning.trace: Remote reads follow external writes immediately.
reasoning.infer: Transient unavailability can exhaust the retry budget.

findings.summary: Required marker schema can lose mechanisms or version-files undetected
findings.suggestion: Add repository-level block-removal controls with path-specific errors.

reasoning.observe: Tests mutate contents but never remove either block.
reasoning.trace: Presence is delegated to production code.
reasoning.infer: An optional-section validator passes every test.

findings.summary: Workflow test checks CLI text but not required nonzero process exits
findings.suggestion: Exercise main or python -m for mismatch/unavailable results and assert nonzero exits.
